audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read Lissandra, while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Katarina on all seven rows — and all seven full-layer whys describe Katarina winning the stage they sit under.
audit.why: A seven-for-seven cross-layer disagreement, with the sentence under each row arguing the opposite of the row. The 51.2% win rate over 5104 games is a Katarina edge.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to Katarina, matching win[0..6] and the packet. Whys untouched — they already argue that verdict.

audit.why: Level 6 is the Frozen Tomb mind game (120s at rank 1), first item is the burst spike, late game she must walk into 550 range to ult. Her lane clock is Ring of Frost at 10s down to 8s and Glacial Path at 24s down to 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracked Glacial Path as the matchup-defining ability when Ring of Frost is: it roots at 450, which is inside Shunpo's 725 range, and it cancels Death Lotus. The brief's missing interaction (Ring of Frost and Frozen Tomb cancelling Death Lotus) was not stated anywhere on the full layer. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Two bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles. dontsFull[2].t warned about 'spell-shield kits' — Lissandra has no spell shield, so it is a non-interaction and a template leak.
audit.why: Katarina's R is an interruptible channel; Ring of Frost is hardCC at 450 range and Frozen Tomb is hardCC. Bouncing Blade's grounding flag also shuts off Glacial Path's reactivate blink, which the page never said.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Ring of Frost 10s to 8s with the 450 root and the Lotus cancel, Glacial Path 24s to 12s, and Frozen Tomb 120s. tradeBad and dontsFull[2] now state the cancel and the untargetable self-Tomb. dosFull[0].d states the grounding. The spell-shield title is replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[2] and content.spikes[0].text both gave Ring of Frost a 12-second cooldown. It is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8.
audit.why: The whole plan on this page is to commit inside that cooldown. Two seconds of imagined window is the difference between the all-in and the root.
51.2% over 5104 games, already cited in whys[5].
